MSC Seaside Review

Review of MSC Seaside

The 2017-built MSC Seaside cruise ship is the first SEASIDE-Class MSC vessel - with sistership MSC Seaview (2018 June). Seaside is also fleet's 14th liner, and the 2nd MSC newbuild entering service in 2017 - following MSC Meraviglia (inaugurated in June).

The vessel (IMO number 9745366) is currently Malta-flagged (MMSI 248392000) and registered in Valletta.

History - construction and ownership

MSC Cruises (MSC Crociere) is a passenger shipping company headquartered in Genoa and Naples. It was established in 1960. Today, MSC Crociere is a subsidiary of MSC (Mediterranean Shipping Company) - the world's 2nd largest containership company. MSC Crociere is the world's largest privately-owned cruise company.

By annual passenger shipping volumes, MSC is ranked the world's 3rd largest cruise shipowner - following only Carnival Corporation and RCG-Royal Caribbean Group.

In 2015, MSC ordered four new ships from STX France and Fincantieri Italy, with an option for three more. The first two liners were delivered in 2017 - Meraviglia (May) and Seaside (November).Seaview was delivered in June 2018. The 5300-passenger Seaside-Class ship design was developed for year-round operations in warm climates. It features many and large-sized outdoor areas, ropes course, 5-slide water park, 3 glass-floored catwalks, wraparound Promenade Deck (at sea level) lined up with shops, bars and restaurants (indoor-outdoor seating), glass-walled (sea view) elevators. Among vessel's technological features are Advanced Water Treatment and garbage treatment plants, new-generation scrubbers, optimized hull, antifouling paints, LED lighting throughout, advanced heat recovery technology. The vessel is fully compliant with IMO's "Safe Return to Port" requirement (how long the cruise ship should remain safe for evacuation).

MSC Seaside is part of the "smart" ships' series to be built by MSC, part of line's EUR 9 billion, 10-year investment plan, including the creation of up to 11 new ships, due to come into service 2017-2026.

MSC Seaside is MSC fleet's second ship (after Meraviglia) fitted with new technologies specifically designed to improve the onboard digital experience for passengers. The company entered a partnership with Samsung to support NFC (near-field communication) technology onboard, enabling passengers to use smartphones, cruise cards or bracelets to geolocate themselves or their kids, to access their stateroom or make onboard payments. Interactive screens are placed throughout the ship to enable passengers to make real-time bookings and reservations. Beacon technology is also used, sending location-based, customized notifications to users' phones as they move around the ship. Beacons are triggered whenever a connected device moves into their vicinity.

Decks and Cabins

MSC Seaside staterooms (2066 total) are in 25 categories and include 1610 Outside and 454 Inside. The largest aboard MSC Seaside is the Yacht Club Royal Suite (670 ft2 / 62 m2 plus 355 ft2 / 33 m2 terrace with an outdoor whirlpool hot tub). The ship has 54 wheelchair-accessible cabins, 14 aft-corner suites, suites with outdoor Jacuzzis, terraced balcony staterooms (overlooking the Promenade) and cluster cabins (designed for families with children). About 73% of all staterooms are with private step-out balconies. Most cabin balconies are sized 45-95 ft2 (4-9 m2).

The boat has 19 decks, of which 16 are passenger-accessible and 10 with cabins.

MSC Seaside decks are named after famous resort beaches.

Shipboard dining options - Food and Drinks

New and creative dining options are available onboard MSC Seaside. Expect the Fusion Restaurant with specialty dining and VIP Fine Dining Restaurant. The 9 onboard eateries feature cuisines from all around the world including the Pan-Asian restaurant via the partnership with acclaimed chef, Roy Yamaguchi, world-class international steak house and luxury seafood restaurant with Chef's Table.

Follows the complete list of MSC Seaside restaurants and food bars.

  • Main restaurants (dining rooms) offer traditional Italian cuisine and wines. Dining rooms are open for Breakfast (7-9:30 am), Lunch (12-noon - 2 pm_ and Dinner with 2 fixed seatings (7 pm and 9:30 pm) with a
  • Seashore Restaurant (922-seat Aft Main Dining Room, size 1670 m2) serves breakfast, lunch (sea days only) and dinner, three fixed seatings, My Choice Dining (between 5:30-9:30 pm). Tables as capacity from 2 to 10 seats.
  • Ipanema Restaurant (766-seat Aft Main Dining Room, size 1475 m2, Deck 6) serves dinner only (three fixed time seatings). Tables as capacity from 2 to 10 seats.
  • Marketplace Buffet Restaurant (1102-seat buffet restaurant, size 2071 m2, Deck 8) with outdoor Promenade Deck seating (tables and chairs). Marketplace's multiple food stations include carvery, pizzeria (including made-to-order pies), fast-food (panini sandwiches, wraps, burgers, hot dogs), salad bar, fruits, vegan, bread and pasta (fresh-baked on the ship), beverage bar. Marketplace Buffet is open between 6.30 am - 2 am. The restaurant is a great choice for late-night pizzas and afternoon snacks. Seaside cruise ship's other buffet restaurant is on Deck 16 (Biscayne Bay Restaurant).
  • Bistrot la Boheme (131-seat food lounge, size 670 m2, Deck 8) operates with a fixed menu charge (EUR 23) or a la carte priced menu: Dining tables are arranged around the Atrium.
  • Ocean Cay by Ramon Freixa (32-seat seafood specialty restaurant, size 130 m2, Deck 9) is at fixed charge pp (EUR 49, pre-set menu) or with ordering from an a la carte priced menu.
  • Asian Market Kitchen by Roy Yamaguchi includes Pan Asian Restaurant by Roy Yamaguchi (30-seat, size 100 m2, Deck 9), Sushi Food Bar by Roy Yamaguchi (40-seat, size 170 m2, with outdoor seating), Teppanyaki Restaurant by Roy Yamaguchi (32-seat, size 100 m2, dinner-only, with live cooking stations)
  • Butcher's Cut (72-seat steakhouse restaurant, size 225 m2, with exclusive Chef's Table, Deck 9) is at fixed charge pp (EUR 49, pre-set menu) or with ordering from an a la carte priced menu. The steakhouse offers brunch (sea days only) with a la carte menu (omelets, carnitas, sandwiches, pancakes, surf-and-turf, desserts, premium wines. Butcher's Cut is open for lunch and dinner.
  • Biscayne Bay Restaurant and Buffet (430-seat buffet restaurant for families and kids, size 1050 m2, Deck 9) is the Seaside ship's second buffet restaurant (the other is Marketplace Buffet on Deck 8). Biscayne Bay Buffet is open between 8-10 pm. Here are also offered themed food dinners. Biscayne Bay has dedicated food counters with children's meals, Pizzeria (pizza by the slice, made-to-order pies), fast-food stations (panini sandwiches, wraps, burgers, hot dogs), fresh-baked bread station, salad bar, fruits bar, vegan food station.
  • MSC YACHT CLUB Restaurant (128-seat, size 630 m2, Deck 18) is part of Top Sail Lounge (upper level) and serves complimentary breakfast, lunch and dinner with no fixed dining times. A different menu is offered every day, reflecting the current cruise itinerary/region of the ship. Top Sail Lounge and its Sundeck and Restaurant are part of an exclusive complex for MSC Yacht Club cabin passengers only.

Shipboard entertainment options - Fun and Sport

MSC Seaside is specifically designed for warm climates. The concept behind MSC Cruises Seaside ship is to "bring the sea closer to passengers. The beach-condo-inspired concept focuses on the outdoor space of suites and cabins, many al fresco eating options (20 bars), outdoor spa and fitness facilities, two wellness cabins with advanced Kinesis Technogym fitness equipment and private MSC Yacht Club, with a restaurant, lounge and solarium.

 

Signature activity areas include Adventure Trail outdoor playground (rope courses, bridges, crawl-through slides) and Zip-Line (length 130 m / 430 ft). The aqua park has 5x waterslides, an interactive Slideboarding tube (combining video games, music, lights, 112-m water slide), Aquatube (innertube slide), 2x high-speed racing slides and 1x family flume-type slide. The waterpark also has 2x separate kids' playgrounds (AquaPlay and AquaSpray).

Additional amenities include complimentary 24-Hour Room-Service and Supervised Children Program, Internet/WiFi Access, Laundry. Follows the complete list of MSC Seaside lounges, clubs and other entertainment venues for kids, teens and adults.

  • Medical Center (16-seat Infirmary, size 251 m2 / 2701 ft2, Deck 4) is the ship’s hospital operated by resident doctors/physicians and nurses on 24-hour duty. Payments are made by the boarding pass (treatments equivalent to a private doctor’s visit). General health insurance policies do not apply, so buying cruise health insurance is recommended.
  • Photo Shop, Art Gallery (16-seat, size 200 m2, Deck 5)
  • Emotions-Immersive Gallery (50-seat photo gallery, size 218 m2, Deck 5)
  • Atrium Lobby Lounge with MSC Future Cruise (19-seat Cruise Consultant Office, size 126 m2), Reception (24-hour Guest Services Desk, 32-seat, size 270 m2), Atrium Bar (Seaside Bar, 77-seat coffee/cocktail bar, size 508 m2, Deck 5)
  • Metropolitan Theatre (Deck 6 / 7) is the ship's main show lounge (capacity 946 seats, size 1313 m2, stage/dance floor surface 190 m2) hosting live classical concerts, operas and all seven Broadway-style evening show productions (on a rotating basis, 4 are performed nightly). Each show includes 5 singers, 15 dancers, 14 variety artists. The shows are named "My Life in Music’ (live performed popular movie soundtracks), ‘The Dream’ (dance show), "The Wizard" (magician show), "Peter Punk" (Peter Pan themed).
  • Retail Shopping Area (duty-free shopping arcade with retail shops and brand-name boutiques, Deck 6), including Fine Watches and Jewellery Shop (size 67 m2), Boutique Accessories (fine bags, fashion accessories, size 64 m2), Boutique Monobrand (fashion shop for men-women-kids, size 64 m2), Perfumes and Cosmetics Shop (size 104 m2), Mini Mall (duty-free shop for tobaccos-liquors-snacks-beverages-toys, size 110 m2)
  • Piazza Grande (square-type area with live music, pastry and ice cream bar, size 630 m2, Deck 6)
  • Venchi 1878 Chocolate Bar (93-seat chocolate factory and coffee bar with an open kitchen by Venchi, size 520 m2)

  • Miami Casino (237-seat gaming lounge, size 1150 m2, Deck 7) served by Casino Bar (35-seat, size 120 m2)

  • Interactive XD Cinema (8-seat Interactive XD Dark Ride Cinema 5D, size 64 m2, Deck 7)

  • Library & Billiard Room (21-seat library lounge with pool table, size 90 m2, Deck 7)

Part of the open-air Promenade Deck are two catwalks (panoramic glass-bottomed platforms with glass railings).   • The "Bridge of Sighs" (Deck 9, aft) is a panoramic catwalk (glass-floored walking platform, with glass railings) for stunning stern ship views of the ocean.

  • Forest Aquaventure Park is the ship's water playground with a wading pool, 4x waterslides (2x racing, 1x slideboarding, 1x standard), water cannons, fountains, playground climbers.
  • Doremi Studio is a theatre-like (TV studio) with a big LED screen and tiered seating, family time games, dance floor, interactive gaming.
  • Baby Club CHICCO is a nursery (babysitting facility via partnership with CHICCO / Italian babywear company). It is open for toddlers from 6 to 36 months old and offers a lot of free baby products (diapers, wipes, bottles, Infant formula, selection of strollers and cots). The nursery has a large TV, colored books and soft play area with age-appropriate toys, a separate room with cots, bathroom. Supervised activities include Mini Olympic games, cooking class, Baby Time (allows parents to play with their kids), Baby Care (allows parents to leave their children / 1-year-old and older for ~90 min in the morning-afternoon-evening). Parents must do the feeding, but the staff change nappies. Nursery's opening hours are between 9 am - 1 pm, 3-6 pm and 8-11:00 pm.
  • Mini Club LEGO is a playroom (for 3-6-year-olds) with Lego and Duplo bricks, cinema, foosball, kids books, crayons, pens, age-appropriate toys, kids programming with supervised activities (sports, arts-crafts, treasure hunts, musical chairs, games, dressing up, cooking in the TV Studio).
  • Junior Club LEGO is a playroom (for 7-11-year-olds) with a brick pit, age-appropriate toys and games, cinema, foosball, supervised activities (games, sports, arts-crafts), educational activities. The two rooms are connected and when opened up create a large playground.
  • Young Club is for tweens (12-14-year-olds) and operates on a different basis from the younger kids' clubs. Programming is offered all day on sea days and only in the afternoon on port days. Facilities include table tennis, foosball, PS4, some double seats in which kids can lounge back to play video games from a TV placed in the ceiling, as well as traditional board games. The most innovative technology asset is a multi-media table allowing kids to post messages and pictures which then get screened on the club's walls. Programming includes generation games, lip sync battles, sports tournaments in the Sportplex. There is a EUR 10 per kid per hour charge for use of the club between 11 pm - 2 am (otherwise access is free).
  • Teen Club is for children 15-17-year-old and has dance floor, plenty of chairs, large TVs, beanbags, video games (PS4, VR, Nintendo). The programming includes virtual gaming, sports and dancing competitions including ping pong and mini-golf.
  • The fore-located MSC Yacht Club Open Area (112-seats, size 1600 m2, Deck 19) is an exclusive sundeck with Swimming Pool (One Pool / MSC Yacht Club Pool), Pool Bar, 2 Solariums each with a large Jacuzzi (spa pool), cabanas (for rental), sunbathing areas with padded loungers and deckchairs. Pool towels are complimentary and provided in the cabins.
  • On deck 19 is also the ship's Sports Court - aft-located multisports court (for basketball-volleyball-tennis) and 2 separate zip lines, each 120 m/393 ft in length. Midship is the Magrodome - retractable roof cover over deck 18's midship pool deck.
  • Miramar Bar (78-seat, with panoramic sea view, Deck 19).

Itineraries

Following MSC Seaside itinerary program started with roundtrips to Caribbean ports and homeporting in Miami Florida USA (starting December 2017). Itineraries included as destinations Bahamas, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Jamaica.

Following the Coronavirus crisis, Seaside was relocated from the Caribbean to Europe for 7-day Mediterranean roundtrips from homeports Civitavecchia-Rome, Genoa, Marseille, Siracusa (Sicily). For winter 2021-2022 (November-March) Seaside was deployed in South America/Brazil (with homeporting in Santos-Sao Paulo.

In winter 2022-2023 (December-April) Seaside operated 7-day and 14-day (B2B) Caribbean voyages leaving out of homeports Fort-de-France (Martinique) and Pointe-a-Pitre (Guadeloupe).

In summer 2023 (April-November) the liner was deployed in the Caribbean and homeported in Port Canaveral/Orlando Florida. The season was based on short breaks (3- and 4-night roundtrips visiting MSC Ocean Cay Bahamas) and 7-night voyages to Mexico (Cozumel and Costa Maya), Belize, and Ocean Cay.

For MSC Seaside's Caribbean 2022-2023 season (December thru April), the company introduced fly-cruise packages for Brazilians inclusive of roundtrip chartered flights (Sao Paulo Guarulhos Airport to Martinique Aime Cesaire Airport and back to Sao Paulo) and all land transfers (airport-cruise port-airport).

MSC Seaside's Brazil-to-Caribbean fly-cruises for winter season 2023-2024 were again based on charter flights, homeporting in Martinique and 3x different (7-day) itineraries:

  • Itinerary 1 visits Point-a-Pitre (Guadeloupe), Castries (St Lucia), Kingstown (St Vincent), Bridgetown (Barbados) and St George (Grenada).
  • Itinerary 2 visits Point-a-Pitre, Rouseau (Dominica), St John’s (Antigua), Basseterre (St Kitts) and Philipsburg (St Maarten).
  • Itinerary 3 visits Point-a-Pitre, Castries, Port-of-Spain (Trinidad), Bridgetown, and St George.

MSC Seaside Wiki

The vessel (Fincantieri Monfalcone yard / hull number 6256) has a volume of 153,516 GT, a deadweight tonnage (DWT) of 11,385 tons, and a maximum draught of 8 m. The power plant consists of four Wärtsilä marine diesel engines (2× 12V46F and 2× 14V46F) with a combined output of 62.4 MW (83,680 hp). Propulsion is provided by two Azipod thrusters with a combined output of 40 MW (53,640 hp). The registered shipowner is MSC MEDITERRANEAN SHIPPING CO (via CNS COMPANIA NAVIERA SEASIDE 1 SA), while the registered manager is MSC CROCIERE S.p.A.

The Fincantieri Monfalcone-built MSC Seaside is the first of the Seaside-class MSC newbuilds and the first MSC cruise ship ever christened in the USA (December 21, 2017, in PortMiami). In 2017, she was also the largest passenger vessel ever constructed by Fincantieri. The second Seaside-class ship (MSC Seaview) was delivered in June 2018. An option for a third Seaside-class vessel (scheduled for 2021) was also included. Another MSC vessel launched in 2017 (May) was MSC Meraviglia.

Samsung supported the installation of near-field communication systems enabling passengers to use a digital device (smartphone, cruise card, or bracelet) to locate themselves or companions onboard, access their cabins, and make onboard payments. Interactive screens throughout the ship allow passengers to book excursions and make restaurant reservations.

On June 22, 2015, the steel-cutting ceremony was held at Fincantieri’s Monfalcone shipyard (Trieste, Italy). The keel-laying ceremony took place on March 4, 2016, when a 550-ton keel block was placed, officially starting the vessel’s construction and block assembly. On April 21, 2016, the traditional coin ceremony was held, during which special-edition coins were placed to bless the ship and bring good luck.

 

The vessel was floated out on November 26, 2016, and delivered to MSC on November 29, 2017. During the delivery ceremony, MSC announced the order of two “Seaside EVO” class ships from Fincantieri (contract value EUR 1.8 billion). These newbuilds are larger—16 m longer, 17,330 GT heavier, and with 467 more passenger capacity—than the Seaside-class sisters Seaview and Seaside. Their scheduled deliveries were 2021 (MSC Seashore) and 2023 (TBN).

Shores Global LLC supplied all the vessel’s outdoor wicker furniture (balconies and pool decks), producing and delivering over 3000 pieces (deckchairs and sun loungers) to the shipyard in October 2017. The company is a major supplier to the cruise industry, offering consulting, materials selection, and production management.

A noteworthy milestone occurred on November 30, 2017, when Marlink (the world’s largest independent satellite Internet provider) delivered a record-breaking 0.5 Gbps throughput on its Sealink VSAT network during the ship’s launch. This was made possible using Intelsat’s EpicNG satellites. Marlink provides satellite Internet services across the MSC fleet via an optimized “cloud of bandwidth,” and as of 2017 its Sealink network included 25 satellites and 32 overlapping beams.

The ship’s official naming ceremony took place in Miami on December 21, 2017, hosted by Mario Lopez. The event headliner was Puerto Rican singer Ricky Martin, performing several hit songs. Andrea Bocelli also appeared, accompanied by a children’s choir from Haiti. Notable attendees included Dan Marino (former Miami Dolphins NFL quarterback). In October 2017, MSC signed an exclusive partnership with the Miami Dolphins, offering MSC passengers the “Dolphins Experience at Sea,” including special appearances on a sports-themed cruise aboard MSC Seaside in 2018.

The ship’s godmother is Sophia Loren, who has christened every new MSC vessel since 2003.

The ship’s design features innovative marine architecture and two separate engine rooms (located forward and aft), along with modern technologies that improve operational efficiency and reduce fuel consumption. The vessel is powered by all four Wärtsilä diesel engines (model 12V46F), with a total power output of 62.4 MW.

MSC’s Dolphins Fan Cruise

The “Dolphins Fan Cruise” (March 17–24) was a 7-day Caribbean & Antilles roundtrip from Miami to Nassau (Bahamas), St Thomas (USVI), and St John’s (Antigua). This special voyage resulted from a three-year partnership between MSC and the NFL team. The annual themed cruise ran between 2017 and 2020. For the 2018 sailing, prices started from USD 700 per person (balcony cabin, double occupancy).

During these sports-themed cruises, passengers could meet and interact with Miami Dolphins alumni. Activities included:

  • Meeting former team legends Joe Rose, Kim Bokamper, Nat Moore, Patrick Surtain, Sam Madison, Terry Kirby
  • Autograph sessions and photo opportunities with the team’s cheerleaders
  • Cheering alongside the Miami Dolphins cheerleaders and mascot “TD”
  • Watching special cheer squad and mascot performances
  • Q&A sessions with former players

On April 28, 2018, MSC Seaside hosted the Miami Dolphins Cheerleaders for their annual calendar photoshoot, along with special onboard programming.

  • Through MSC’s “Save & Sail” promotion, passengers could book a balcony cabin on the “Cheerleaders Voyage” starting at USD 650 per person. Off-promo prices started from USD 1098 per person (Inside cabin, double occupancy).
  • The Cheerleaders Cruise itinerary (April 28–May 5) was a 7-day roundtrip from Miami to St Maarten, Puerto Rico, and Nassau (Bahamas).

Caribbean cruise itineraries 2017

MSC Seaside operates year-round Caribbean cruises from Florida (PortMiami), starting December 2017. In early 2015, MSC announced that Seaside’s year-round Miami program would benefit from a newly expanded cruise terminal and exclusive MSC berth at PortMiami.

  • In mid-December 2015, MSC opened bookings for Seaside. The Inaugural Cruise departed Miami on December 21, 2017. Bookings first opened exclusively to MSC Voyager Club members (Dec 15–29), who received their standard 5% discount plus an all-inclusive drink package (Classic Beverage Package for 1st and 2nd guest on 7+ night cruises).
  • On December 29, 2015, bookings opened to the general public. All bookings made before January 31, 2016, included the Classic all-inclusive drink package.
  • Initial booking prices started from USD 590 per person (Inside cabin, double occupancy).

Miami departures are at 7:00 pm. Port times include:

  • Nassau, Bahamas (12:00 pm – 8:00 pm)
  • Ocean Cay, Bahamas (9:00 am – 11:55 pm) – MSC Cruises’ private island
  • Cozumel, Mexico (10:00 am – 6:00 pm)
  • Ocho Rios, Jamaica (11:00 am – 5:00 pm)
  • St Thomas, USVI (8:00 am – 4:00 pm)
  • Grand Cayman (9:00 am – 4:00 pm)
  • San Juan, Puerto Rico (7:00 am – 2:00 pm)

Prices for 7-day Eastern or Western Caribbean itineraries from Miami start at approximately USD 640 per person.

  • The 7-day Eastern Caribbean itinerary visits Nassau (Bahamas), St Thomas (USVI, overnight), San Juan (Puerto Rico), and Ocean Cay (Bahamas).
  • The 7-day Western Caribbean itinerary visits Ocho Rios (Jamaica), Grand Cayman, Cozumel (Mexico), and Ocean Cay (Bahamas).
